calculation.description: Fades the same-day open-to-close move, increasing reversal strength when contemporaneous volume is elevated relative to its trailing 20-session median. The signal is computed using completed daily OHLCV only.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.100661, 690 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.076548, 459 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.030340, 531 dates). Small cross-asset universe and selective volume availability warrant conservative sizing.
